guide: Open Start here and type your names, the wedding day, the reply-by date, the seated capacity and the price per guest in the yellow cells. Replace demo data: clear the sample rows and type your own.

Fill Households first: one row per invitation (one invitation, several people) with side, tier, list, region, number of guests and lodging. Then list each person in Guests with an age group, an RSVP, a meal and a short dietary note.
Mark the A list (the first invitations) and the B list (the second wave when someone declines). The B List Queue ranks the B households and the B List Cascade names the next one to invite.
Type the RSVP as replies arrive. The RSVP Chase List ranks the silent households and Replies by Week shows the pace; the Reply Pace Forecast says if you are on pace before the reply-by date.

Edit the Expected Yes Rates by region (a typical starting value, not a fact about your area). The Forecast by Tier and the Final Headcount Forecast give low, likely and high and the number to give the caterer.
Compare the headcount with the seated capacity in the Capacity Traffic Light and test your plus-one and children policy in Policy Options and Policy Results.
Type each meal choice and a few words of dietary note only. Meal Counts, Meals by Table and the Caterer Meal Order follow from the replies.
Use the Invitation Timeline and Paper and Postage for the dates and the cost of the paper; the total feeds the stationery line of your budget.
Type the room block nights and the rooms picked up; Room Pickup lists the households that need a room and the Room Block tools show the rooms still to fill and the cost if the block is not filled.
Use the 18 tools, print 12 sheets and 12 pages, follow 12 checklists and tap a message link to send a text with the details written in.
A couple with a small wedding (30 guests, no B list) uses the same sheets with fewer rows: keep one tier, skip the B List Queue and leave the room block empty.
This workbook has no macros and works in Excel and Google Sheets. Print any page for a parent or a helper.
Why a workbook: one flat price, no vendor ever sees your details, no fees on your gifts, your own numbers, and it works offline.
What this is not: not a booking service, not a payment service, and not legal, tax or insurance advice. Every default is a typical starting value you can edit, never a promise.

listing.headline: Guest list, RSVPs, headcount and room block for your wedding
listing.description:
Plan the guest side of your wedding in one Excel workbook. Built for an engaged couple planning their own wedding, with a parent or a wedding party lead helping to chase replies. Households holds one row per invitation (one invitation, several people) with side, tier, list, region and RSVP, and Guests holds each guest with an age group, a meal and a few words of dietary note. Names only: no addresses and no health details.

The forecast does the thinking. Confirmed yes plus pending households at the yes rate you edit for each region gives a low, likely and high headcount, the cost at each figure and the number to give the caterer. The Capacity Traffic Light tests the headcount against the seated capacity, the B List Cascade names the next B list household when declines open seats, and the RSVP Chase List ranks the silent households by guests at stake, days silent and contact status.

Meal Counts, Meals by Table and a Caterer Meal Order reconcile the meals with the headcount. The Plus-one and Children Policy test compares four policies by headcount and food cost. The Guarantee Exposure tool shows what you pay for empty seats, and the room block sheets show the rooms still to fill and the cost if the block is not filled. The Invitation Timeline and Paper and Postage price the paper.

18 tools answer weekly questions. Print 12 sheets and 12 pages, follow 12 checklists and send 34 ready text messages to guests, parents, the caterer, the venue, the hotel contact and the printer. A standard .xlsx workbook with no macros and no subscription, with a demo copy full of sample data to explore first. Every default is a typical starting value you can edit and forecasts are your own estimate. It is not a booking service, not a payment service and not legal, tax or insurance advice. This is part two of the Wedding Planning suite.

Please reply by {col:households.rsvp_deadline}. If you stay in the hotel block, please book by {col:households.room_cutoff}. Tell us a meal choice for each guest and any short dietary note.
We will send the travel and hotel details with your invitation.
documents.note: Sample wording: adapt it to your own wedding and your own guests.

ar.One row per side and tier: households, g: صف واحد لكل جهة وفئة: الأسر والضيوف والنسبة مقابل التقسيم المتفق عليه؛ وتُحسب تلقائياً الجهة الأثقل ورسالة الوالدين.

ar.The B list households in the order you i: أسر القائمة (ب) بترتيب دعوتها: الفئة أولاً ثم الأسر الأصغر. وتُحسب الحالة والمقاعد التي تشغلها كل أسرة من ورقة الأسر المدعوة.

ar.Households to chase in order: silent rep: الأسر المطلوب متابعتها بالترتيب: الذين لم يردوا أولاً بحسب الضيوف المعنيين وأيام الصمت وحالة التواصل، ثم الوجبات والمرافقون والتحقق من التواصل. ويتجاوز ترتيب الاتصال الأسر التي تابعتها مؤخراً.
ar.One row per week from the first invitati: صف واحد لكل أسبوع منذ أول دعوة: الضيوف الذين ردوا بنعم أو لا، ونسبة من ردّ من كل الضيوف بنهاية الأسبوع.

ar.One row per meal choice: how many yes gu: صف واحد لكل وجبة: عدد الضيوف المؤكدين الذين اختاروها ونسبتها. أضف نسبة الزيادة في أداة طلب مقدم الضيافة.
ar.One row per table: guests, each meal cho: صف واحد لكل طاولة: الضيوف وكل وجبة والأطفال وملاحظات غذائية قصيرة، جاهزة لمقدم الضيافة ولبطاقات المقاعد. وتغذّي الإجماليات رسائل مقدم الضيافة.

ar.Four ways to treat plus-ones and childre: أربع طرق للتعامل مع الضيوف المرافقين والأطفال: كم عدد كل فئة ستحسب. عدّل الأرقام وفق سياستك.
ar.Headcount and food cost for each policy:: العدد وتكلفة الطعام لكل سياسة: البالغون المدعوون بالاسم مضافاً إليهم المرافقون والأطفال الذين تحسبهم السياسة.
ar.One row per invitation step with its pla: صف واحد لكل خطوة من خطوات الدعوة مع تاريخها المخطط؛ وتُحسب تلقائياً الأسابيع قبل حفل الزفاف والأيام المتبقية والحالة. ضع علامة في تم عند الإرسال.

ar.Households that stay in the block or arr: الأسر التي تقيم ضمن الحجز أو ترتب إقامتها بنفسها: الغرف المطلوبة والوصول وهل الغرفة محجوزة. وتغذّي إجماليات الحجز رسائل الفندق.

ar.Minimum guarantee, guests you pay for: الحد الأدنى المضمون، عدد الضيوف الذين تدفع عنهم
ar.Exposure at the low headcount less one s: المخاطر عند العدد المنخفض ناقصاً خطوة

ar.Silent households you chased in the last: الأسر التي لم ترد وتابعتها في الأيام الأخيرة
